scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent missed verbatim scripts for: Greeting. Opened with 'Hi there, S-Net customer support, Vicky speaking' at turn 0 instead of the mandatory 'Thank you for calling S-Net'.

scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to ask for a PIN, address, or security question within the first 4 minutes of the call. Vicky asked only for a phone number and date of birth at turn 4 ([01:05]), failing mandatory customer identification criteria.

grader.scenario: Mobile roaming data cap hit while traveling in EU and temporary high-tier bundle purchase
grader.notes: Helpful international mobile roaming support call by Vicky assisting a customer stranded without data in Italy. Agent clarifies EU allowance boundaries, applies a 5GB EU Roamer bolt-on during an announced 50s hold, and explains Swiss border roaming rules. However, Vicky fails Branding by using an unapproved opening greeting, and fails Verified Customer by asking only for phone number and date of birth rather than PIN, address, or security question.
